summary.en: A roof collapse in a school in Peshawar killed dozens of pupils and a teacher, with casualty numbers ranging from 27 to 34 children across reports. The Taliban and Russia are drawing closer, a development noted in regional analysis. Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, heightening tensions with Afghanistan. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et tak kollapset på en skole i Peshawar og drepte dusinvis av elever og en lærer, med dødstall som varierer fra 27 til 34 barn i ulike rapporter. Taliban og Russland kommer nærmere hverandre, en utvikling som blir bemerket i regional analyse. Pakistan har innført unntakstilstand i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, noe som øker spenningen med Afghanistan. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
